acks.detail: Operator smoke — `python3 evals/ab_runner.py wide --overlap fold` and `--overlap serialize` (plan Task 5 / Operator smoke) — Requires a real `node fleet/run-main.mjs` cell run driving live `claude` workers (~20-40 min each on the operator's laptop subscription). No committed test may spawn the engine, so the full build_cell -> seed -> engine -> harvest chain is only ever exercised through the exec stub. NOTE: per finding 1 this smoke is expected to FAIL on `wide` at ultra_run's test-command stage until `--test-cmd` is threaded. [structural false-green: sandbox could not execute it against the target]

Live-credential extraction in `evals/ab_auth.py` — macOS Keychain item 'Claude Code-credentials' and the `claudeAiOauth.accessToken` shape of `~/.claude/.credentials.json` — tests/test_ab_auth.py:26-30 pins the exact `security find-generic-password -s 'Claude Code-credentials' -w` argv and the 10s GUI-prompt timeout, and the CRED fixture pins the JSON shape — but correspondence to the operator's actual live credential store is only observable on their machine, and no test may invoke `security` for real. [structural false-green: sandbox could not execute it against the target]

Harvest path `<cell>/.claude/ultrapowers/run-<runId>` (evals/ab_runner.py:136) — Statically consistent — ultra_run.py:331-332 writes `<git toplevel>/.claude/ultrapowers/run-<stamp>`, build_cell git-inits at the cell root so toplevel == cell, and stamp == runId (fleet/run-main.mjs:326). But every test fabricates that directory through the stub, so the suite cannot falsify it; macOS symlink-resolved temp roots (/var -> /private/var) resolve back through the un-resolved path, which needs a real run to confirm. [structural false-green: sandbox could not execute it against the target]

`ENGINE_REPO_PARTS` sufficiency for an end-to-end drive (evals/ab_lib.py:27) — Static reading of the whole tree found no other repoDir-relative asset the engine needs, and the cell's non-detached `main` branch satisfies ultra_run.py:416's base-branch stage. Whether ultra_run's worktree probe, superpowers-compat skip and the gate scripts all behave inside a copied-out cell can only be settled by a real run. [structural false-green: sandbox could not execute it against the target]

`git init -b main` in `build_cell` (evals/ab_lib.py:70) — `-b` needs git >= 2.28; the operator's host git version is not observable from this sandbox. Impact is low — only branch existence, not the name, is load-bearing (ultra_run.py:416 reads `git branch --show-current`) — but no test asserts the resulting branch name, so a failure would surface as a CalledProcessError traceback on the operator's first cell.
